notes.title: Two Endless Map Released
notes.content:
Hi Everyone
We've uploaded two endless maps (one desert map and one ice field map).
You can review your score in leader board after the level over. 
We've also fix some tiny bugs and do some optimizations. 
Hope you like and enjoy it!

notes.title: New Endless Map Released
notes.content:
Hi Everyone
We've uploaded an endless map and a new wizard hero, in this map you can command two heroes to cooperate in stopping monsters into your castle. You also can review your leader board after the level over.  
We've also completed a lot of optimization. 
Hope you like and enjoy it!

[b]Merry Christmas & Happy New Year![/b]

notes.title: Oculus Touch support and The First Anniversary Discount
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

We've been developing this game for a year by the end of this month. We would like to take this opportunity to thank all of you. Without your support, it's hard for us to persist till now. 

As we mentioned before, we've added Oculus Touch support after the 12 basic maps. For next step we'll continue to add new content according our plan and your suggestions. 

Your reviews and suggestions have given us a big encourages, if you like the game or have any thoughts on it, we are looking forward to hear from you .
Thank you!

notes.title: New Content Released
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

We are keep working on the new content and updating the current version according to players' suggestion. Below is the list we've update for this time:
 [list]
    [*][b]Add 3 new ice field maps with 2 new player skills.[/b]
    [*][b]Add 11 new monsters.[/b]
    [*][b]Add specific music for each region.[/b]
    [*][b]Increase max adjustable height of the game table.[/b]
    [*][b]Fix some tiny bugs. [/b] 
[/list] 
Hope you will like it and enjoy it, Please feel free to keep giving us your feedbacks and suggestions.
Thanks you all !!!

notes.title: New Maps and Monsters are Available
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

Thanks for your patience, we have released 4 new maps and 11 new monsters. These 4 new maps are more complexes than the first 5 maps, and have much more game play time. Hope you will like it and enjoy it.

Guys, it's the first time we launched a game in public way, your feedback is so important to us. We have read each review and suggestion carefully,They really have given us a big encourages. We are busy to working on the game, have no time to reply you one by one. Just want to say "thank you!" here.

In addition to developing new content, we also fixed some tiny bugs. If you think this game is not bad, hope you are willing to leave a recommend review here. It's means a lot to us.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone
We are working on the maps now and updating the current version according to players' suggestion as well. 
Hope we could release 1-2 new maps in next update, for this time we have:
[list]
[*][b]Added tower type descriptions.[/b]
[*][b]Adjusted difficulty ramp for first 5 maps.[/b]
[*][b]Allow player put down the boulder if have picked it up but don't want to throw it for some reason, without losing one boulder.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed some tiny bugs.[/b]
[/list]
Thanks a lot for your support and suggestions.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Replace Pad button by Grip button for teleport to avoid any unexpected teleport while building towers.
[*]Add a master settings button which is the parent of all sub-settings buttons to avoid touching "Quit" or "Restart" button accidentally.
[*]Fix tiny bugs.
[*]Add some tips for new starter.
[/olist]
